verdict.rationale: While Medusa's self-hosted architecture and 'Instant previews on PRs' (medusa-docs-11) suggest general dev/staging capabilities, there is no evidence of a dedicated sandbox environment specifically for AI-native testing against non-production data (e.g., a test mode for the MCP server or API keys scoped to sandbox data). missing for 10: explicit sandbox/test environment documentation, AI-agent-specific test mode, isolation guarantees separating sandbox from production data.
